events.title: A Normal Quiz Game | Demo Update v0.2
events.summary: A brand new Demo update is now live!FeaturesOrganized settings menu into tabs and added new settings for Screen Shake, Graphics Quality and Increasing TimersPausing now actually stops the gameReworked Christmas question to be based on Halloween instead, so it's less region basedAdded new options for you to do your taxesA few small bug fixes!Join the DiscordIf you would like to provide feedback, report bugs, or chat about the game then feel free to join the discord!Thanks for playing!
